text:
Anya: Quick sync — finalizing GA acceptance criteria for the Keepalive rollout. Need sign-off on SLA targets, pricing-meter tests, runbooks, monitoring alerts, and canary windows. Who owns what?
Sam: I can own SLA thresholds and load-test signoff. Proposal: hosted p99 < 250ms, availability 99.95% for GA, Dedicated 99.9% with throughput guarantees. Thoughts? :thinking_face:  
Mike: That sounds reasonable for hosted. For runtime we need fallback mappings (quantized variant) and an agreed rollback window. Also: define burst policy for the first 72h of traffic.
Jess: I’ll take docs + runbooks (user-facing howto + oncall playbook). Will need examples for pricing calculator and a short billing-smoke guide.
Anya: Owners recap: Sam = SLA + load tests, Mike = runtime fallbacks + rollback policy, Jess = docs + billing-smoke. Ops: can you create the intake tickets and set the canary cadence? @ops-bot?
ops-bot: Created INF-4523 (SLA & load tests), INF-4524 (Canary plan), INF-4525 (Billing smoke). Links: https://go/infra/INF-4523 
Sam: Quick note on tests: we'll run two tiers — synthetic p95/p99 latency for 50k qps and an e2e workload with real prompt distribution. Pass criteria: p99 within target and no error-rate >0.1% sustained for 10m.
Mike: Canary cadence suggestion: 6% traffic for 24h, 20% for 24h, then 100% if stable. During canary we keep a cheap fallback route to the previous model family for <1% of requests.
Jess: Runbook checklist (short):
```
- Who to page (SRE rotation)
- Quick rollback command + owner
- Metric thresholds (error rate, p99, success rate)
- Customer escalation template
- Postmortem owner
```
Anya: Pricing gating: need a billing sample that shows per-request and per-embedding costs across small/medium/large seq lengths. Jess + Finance to coordinate.
Sam: Observability: dashboards for per-route p95/p99, request size histogram, token-cost estimates, and a regression alert on model-quality (via eval harness). Need tracing hooks added by runtime team.
Mike: I'll add tracing hooks and the fallback switch. One ask: surface KV-cache hit-rate in dashboard. That materially affects latency.
Jess: Docs timeline: draft runbook + user pricing examples by EOD Wed, final by next Tue after review.
Anya: Decision checklist for GA gate (we agreed in sync):
- SLA validated by load tests (owner: Sam)
- Runbook and user docs complete and reviewed (owner: Jess)
- Billing-smoke passed and pricing examples verified (owner: Jess + Finance)
- Canary plan executed with no SLO breaches for 48h (owner: Mike + SRE)
- Observability dashboards + regression alerts in place (owner: Sam)
If any item fails, we delay GA and execute rollback/cutover playbook.
Sam: Noted. I'll schedule the synthetic runs and post results in this thread.
Mike: Will push the fallback PR and add KV metrics. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jess: Starting doc drafts now, will @mention owners for review.
Anya: Thanks all — small follow-ups in the tickets. Tag me if anything looks like a showstopper. :thumbsup:
